fw.executor.docs: Setup, adapters and warnings: docs/FIREWALL-EDITOR.md in the repository.
fw.executor.lead_ext: A separate executor service holds the controller access. It checks every plan's passkey signature itself, runs its own safety checks, backs up, watches and rolls back on its own.
fw.executor.lead_sim: Lanloom runs in simulation mode: a built-in executor applies plans to a sample network and never contacts a device. Real changes need the separate executor service, a controller adapter and an explicit arming step by the operator.
fw.executor.no_keys: No passkey yet. Add one in the settings; the executor only accepts plans signed by a pinned passkey.
fw.executor.title: Executor

fw.nostate.text: The executor has not reported the network yet. Check that it runs and uses the same token as the app.
fw.nostate.title: No controller data yet
fw.preview.needs_secure: Signing with a passkey needs a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost).
fw.preview.protect_sim: This is a simulation: the same steps run against the sample network (back up, change, watch, roll back if needed). Nothing leaves Lanloom.
fw.preview.protect_text: Before anything changes, the executor backs up every touched setting. Afterwards it watches the network for {min} minutes and puts everything back by itself if something breaks. You can undo the change for 24 hours.
fw.preview.title: What happens

wizard.account.code_text: It is printed in the container log on first start (and stored in setup-code.txt in the data volume). On the command line:
wizard.account.lead: Lanloom always asks for a sign-in. The first account needs the one-time setup code from the container log, so nobody else on your network can claim this instance.
wizard.account.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
wizard.account.title: Create your account
wizard.connect.lead: With credentials you provide, Lanloom can read live data from your home-automation hub, MQTT broker and router or switch.
wizard.connect.safety: All connections are read-only by design. Credentials are stored encrypted in the data volume and are never shown again.
wizard.connect.title: Connect more sources (optional)
wizard.done.lead: Two last choices. Both can be changed later in Settings.
wizard.done.title: Your map is ready
wizard.networks.isolated_text: It cannot see your home network directly, so device announcements will not be found. For full discovery start the container with host networking (see the install guide). You can still enter your network range below.
wizard.networks.isolated_title: Lanloom runs in an isolated container network
wizard.networks.lead: Lanloom found these networks on this host. Only private address ranges can be scanned.
wizard.networks.manual_hint: Private ranges only, at most 1024 addresses (/22).
wizard.networks.none: No local network was detected. Add your network range below.
wizard.networks.pick_one: Please choose at least one network.
wizard.networks.title: Which networks belong to you?
wizard.passkey.lead: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN next time. You can always use the password as well.
wizard.passkey.title: Add a passkey?
wizard.review.lead: Each device was sorted automatically: {sure} sure, {probable} probable, {unknown} unknown. Rename or re-sort anything that looks wrong — you can change it later, too.
wizard.review.none: No devices were found. Check the selected network and that Lanloom uses host networking.
wizard.review.title: {n} devices found
wizard.scan.consent: I own this network or have permission to scan it.
wizard.scan.deep_text: Additionally checks about 200 common ports per device. Takes longer and may show up in the logs of security devices.
wizard.scan.fineprint: Lanloom only scans private address ranges you selected, never the internet, and never tries to log in anywhere.
wizard.scan.gentle_1: Reads the neighbour table of this host
wizard.scan.gentle_3: Checks 26 well-known service ports per device
wizard.scan.gentle_4: Rate-limited to about 40 connections per second
wizard.scan.lead: Lanloom now looks for devices and services in {nets}. Nothing is changed on any device.
wizard.scan.title: Discover your network
